from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, math
def tops(n):
    im=np.array(Image.open('observations/%s.png'%n).convert('RGB')).astype(int)
    R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
    fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&(R-B>15)
    t={}
    for u in range(512):
        c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
        if len(c): t[u]=int(c.min())
    return t
t=tops('obs_0001')
print('FRAME1 pose (0,0) h=0  -> x=D*(u-256)/256, y=D')
for u in range(60,200,4):
    if u not in t: continue
    v=t[u]; D=396.8/(v-256); print('u%3d v%3d  x=%6.2f y=%6.2f'%(u,v,D*(u-256)/256.,D))
" 2>/dev/null
